systematic_bugs.bug: PLACEHOLDER_PATTERNS contains re.compile(r'placeholder', re.IGNORECASE) - bare word, always matches HTML placeholder= attributes and YAML key names
front-matter regex re.match(r'^---\s*\n...') is not BOM-tolerant; one BOM char disables whole-front-matter parsing and degrades to body scan
title extraction regex [^\"'\n]+ truncates at apostrophes - any English title containing ' is truncated and misjudged as too short. Systematic, reproducible.
